text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm bringing artemis-3b (int8) onto dev-staging for a quick smoke. Need a focused sanity pass today.

Alex: TL;DR checklist I want run in order:
- boot model on dev-staging node (no autoscale)
- run 10 canonical prompts (instr + recency + numeric)
- tokenization roundtrip check (encode/decode)
- streaming + early-stop behavior
- run automated eval harness (short set) and attach results
- note any quality regressions or crashes, tag eng-runtime if infra weirdness

Ravi: +1. Priority? quality vs perf?

Alex: Quality first (safety/instruction following/regressions) — perf after. If automated eval shows >1 regressions mark P0 and rollback.

Tess: I'll run the canonical list now. Quick note: last time int8 had a KV-cache alignment quirk that truncated after ~500 tokens. I'll watch long-stream prompts.

Tess: Ran first 3 prompts. Observed truncation on a long-recall prompt. Log:
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:05Z] model_init: loaded artemis-3b-int8, quant backend: int8-llama-kvopt
[2026-03-20T14:12:24Z] stream_out: stopped after 514 tokens, client still reading
[2026-03-20T14:12:24Z] error: kv_cache_mismatch detected between layers 8-9
```

Tess: tagging @eng-runtime — could be kernel selection issue on this GPU type.

Alex: Good find. Ravi — can you replicate on a different host? Also run tokenization roundtrip: encode the prompt and decode, ensure equality.

Ravi: Replicated on host-23 (same GPU family). Tokenization roundtrip passes for short prompts but the long-stream sample decodes with missing suffix. Running eval harness now.

eval-bot: Automated eval job 2468209999-ev1 completed. Summary: 10 probes run, 2 failures flagged.
- failure 1: factual date hallucination on 'When was the Redwood Inference Series B?' expected 2022, model answered 2021.
- failure 2: code formatting regression — missed closing brace in small JS snippet.
Overall avg answer score: 0.86.

Marie: For int8 we sometimes see subtle rounding causing tokenizer offset shifts for long sequences. Try hybrid strategy: quantize weights but keep KV-caching as fp16 (if runtime supports) and re-run. Also compare to the fp16 baseline to triage whether failure is quantization-only.

Oliver: Also lock RNG (seed=42) and temp=0 for evals so we get deterministic diffs. If hallucination is deterministic that's a blocker.

Tess: Re-ran eval with seed locked and hybrid KV fp16 fallback. Results: regression 1 disappeared, regression 2 still present but reduced. Looks like two separate issues: quantization rounding for dates, and a tokenizer->generation postprocessing bug for code blocks.

Alex: OK. Action items:
- P0: fix tokenizer postprocessing for code blocks (owner: Tess)
- P0: add hybrid KV fp16 fallback as a config experiment (owner: Ravi + eng-runtime)
- P1: perf/throughput run after fixes (owner: Oliver)
- Add a short note in model-onboard doc with these results and attach eval artifacts.

ci-bot: deploy job started for branch artemis/int8-smoke -> dev-staging (sha: a1b2c3d).
ci-bot: deploy job succeeded (deploy id: 2468209999-1). :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks team. I'm marking the thread as the intake record for this bring-up. I'll update the model onboard board and flag for a canary after fixes. If anyone sees other weirdness paste logs here. :thumbsup:

Tess: I'll open the tokenizer PR and reference this thread.

Ravi: Will prototype the hybrid KV fallback today and post results.

Marie: If needed I can triage with a small numeric/date-specific probe set to be exhaustive.

Alex: Perfect. Thanks.
